metric_type_note: All 77 trials on ONE engine: PerformanceAnalytics::Return.portfolio (monthly weights @ month-end t, forward returns @ month-end t+1, b1_step3 precedent) + per-name |dW|x15bps both-leg delta cost (= v2.4_delta semantics in weight space, drift-aware via BOP/EOP) + contracts build_benchmark_compare PORT_t NW lag-3 (forge-identical function). NOT forge build_bt_result 'backtested'. Weighting method carried in SEPARATE weighting_method column. Label schema corrected 2026-06-12 (Q-Lead approval): metric_type restored to enum value 'canonical_screen' ('canonical_screen_weighted' was outside the enum; measurement numbers unchanged).

label_schema.weighting_method_column: per-trial weighting method (was wrongly encoded in metric_type)

selection_protocol.rule: argmax IS net SR only; OOS used solely for non-degradation confirm

protocol_deviations.engine: Prereg named run_monthly_simulation; its dispatch cannot express 17/22 registered methods without modifying 02_Infrastructure (hardcoded 150d lookback < 756d HRP window; lambda-tilt absent; W09/HRP-grid/B06-11 absent). Per prereg identical-months comparability rule, ALL trials run on the contract-blessed Return.portfolio monthly pattern instead. Reported, not silently absorbed.
protocol_deviations.common_start: Prereg expected S1/S2 ~2005-03, S3 ~2008-02 under premise 'RAWDATA from 2002-03'. Actual RAWDATA cache spans 1990-01~. Registered RULE (756d window available AND scores exist) applied literally -> S1 2004-01, S2 2002-03+, S3 2005-02+, B = first month with 36m sleeve history.
protocol_deviations.s2_liquidity: ADV(20d Close*Vol, t-1) >= 2e8 added at selection (immutable constraint; original module used share-volume percentile only)
protocol_deviations.s3_capping: top-25 plain (original n=30 + buffer_zone 50/25 dropped; prereg-registered cap)
protocol_deviations.window_basis: IS/OOS/2017+ cut on FORMATION month (w_idx); IS returns realize through 2019-01
protocol_deviations.s3_identity_period: S3 trial months held to registered substrate identity (registry 2005-02~, 'scores from 2005-02' premise in prereg common_start_rule). 2026-06-10 factor-db rebuild extended C19 scores to 2000-04, which would silently widen the substrate and leave 2000-04~2004 cov windows truncated (ret_s3 slice from 2001-09). Formation w_idx >= 2005-02-01. Decided PRE-measurement, documented (registration_rule compliance).
protocol_deviations.forward_month_completeness: S2/S3 formation months kept only where the forward month is fully realized (w_idx <= 2026-04-30; RAWDATA ends mid-month 2026-06-12). Prevents fabricated all-zero final month (Ret_1m NA->0) and a partial-month forward return. S1/B end 2026-03/2026-02 naturally. Decided PRE-measurement, documented.
protocol_deviations.s3_factor_db_env_shim: prep_s1b_s3.R: unqualified open_dataset() shadowed during VERBATIM source of STR_1550 factor_engine.R - .cache/factor_db gained build_hash.txt (Gate 13.1, 2026-06-11) which breaks arrow schema inference on the directory; shim passes the explicit factor_db_*.parquet file list (identical files). No factor value changed.

alive_criteria: IS dSR>=+0.10 AND OOS dSR>=0 AND full dMDD<=+2pp vs same-substrate baseline
